title: Finding joy in a simple life
en: every weekday i shut down my classroom going through the same routine of wiping tables and chairs resetting the children's activities and reflecting on the day my life often feels quite ordinary i'm tired at the end of my shifts and look forward to going home relaxing and settling into a good book on still autumn afternoons i like to walk through the aspen groves and visit

with the cottonwoods within a month they have burst into a storm of color that puts me in a nostalgic mood it's time to appeal to my inner child and sail some fairy boats skip stones and imagine far-off lands full of whimsy and wonder in the midst of all this beauty i remember why i aspire to live quietly working a job that serves my community

and pursuing my hobbies without worrying about success as defined by someone else's standards as children we are asked what we want to be when we grow up the accepted answer is often a profession of some sort in my case i wanted to be either a veterinarian or a narwhal writer we are not often asked if we will grow up to be kind or gentle or helpful will we be givers or takers will we be our own best friend and will we be open to the possibility that we are sometimes wrong in our way of thinking and that people and opportunities come our way in order to challenge our minds and strengthen our souls
do my life is full of routines and

inconsequential moments but when magnified they become far more meaningful holding my student's hand the raindrops on a spider's web the smell of freshly grated beeswax even something as mundane as bringing my own bags to the grocery store little experiences like these are what make up most of my life and consequently it makes sense to find beauty and purpose in them for example the most exciting thing i did this week was try to learn how to make dipped candles it was a lot more challenging than i thought it would be and required patience that i did not have at the time but i really enjoyed it anyway and know that my future attempts
will only improve i recently came across a passage in a book that spoke of how our actions

define who we are and after that our thoughts and words it made me think about the proudest moments in my own life when i did not want to do something and yet still did because i knew it was right i used to feel guilty about this because in my heart i had felt selfish at the time and yet chose to have my actions tell a different story that i think is what actually mattered the real challenge in my own life is applying those acts of kindness to myself i had a lot of work to do this evening and did not want to take a moment to slow down and recharge and communicate to others that i needed some time alone but i did and let my worries rest a while as i engross myself in the story
and peaceful thoughts i've not yet mastered the act of kindness to oneself but i am learning you
zh: 每个工作日我都会关掉教室，进行同样的例行公事，擦拭桌椅，重新安排孩子们的活动，并反思这一天。
一个月之内，三叶杨就爆发出一场色彩风暴，让我陷入怀旧的心情，是时候吸引我内心的孩子，航行一些仙女船，跳过石头，想象遥远的土地，在这一切美景中充满奇思怪想和奇迹，我记得为什么我渴望安静地生活，做一份为社区服务的工作

追求自己的爱好，而不用担心别人的标准所定义的成功。 当我们还是孩子时，我们被问到长大后我们想做什么，公认的答案通常是某种职业，就我而言，我想成为一名兽医或独角鲸作家，我们不会经常被问到我们长大后是否会变得善良、温柔或乐于助人，我们会成为给予者还是索取者，我们会成为自己最好的朋友，我们是否会接受这样的可能性，即我们的思维方式有时是错误的，而人们会认为我们的想法是错误的。机遇来临，挑战我们的思想，强化我们的灵魂
我的生活充满了例行公事吗
无关紧要的时刻，但当放大时，它们变得更有意义 握着学生的手 蜘蛛网上的雨滴 新鲜磨碎的蜂蜡的气味 甚至像把自己的包带到杂货店这样平凡的事情 像这样的小经历构成了我生活的大部分，因此在其中找到美和目的是有意义的 例如，我本周所做的最令人兴奋的事情是尝试学习如何制作浸过的蜡烛，这比我想象和要求的更具挑战性我当时没有耐心，但无论如何我真的很享受它并且知道我未来的尝试
只会有所改善 我最近在一本书中看到一段话，谈到我们的行为如何

定义我们是谁，之后我们的想法和言语让我想起自己生命中最自豪的时刻，当时我不想做某事，但仍然做了，因为我知道这是对的，我曾经对此感到内疚，因为在我心里，我当时感到自私，但选择让我的行为讲述一个不同的故事，我认为这才是真正重要的，我自己生活中真正的挑战是将这些善意的行为应用到自己身上，今晚我有很多工作要做，不想花点时间放慢脚步充电并与其他人沟通，我需要一些独处的时间，但我做到了，当我全神贯注于故事时，让我的忧虑休息一会儿
和平静的思想我还没有掌握对自己友善的行为，但我正在学习你
